Good. I've been given a 5 story building utside Shanghai (see below pictures). In 2017, it will be the world's
first Transformative Arts and Technology Centre (see attached). Will offer post graduate degrees recognised by
the US and China. Setting up something like Singularity University, but focused on the "inner dimensions," with
research labs and commercialisation. Will also help global companies in this space line up manufacturing and
explore the China market. In 2016, I will run a series of transformational festivals in the building.
Headed to Shanghai tomorrow to meet with potential investors for the attached deck (Zenso). Its a medical
grade HRV monitor that vibrates when the sympathetic becomes too active (for stress / anxiety management).
I'll be in LA, Vegas, and SF next week. Am running a workshop for elites of the emerging cannabis industry.
Would stop by New York, but I'm required to read the names of the graduates of the program that I head
(graduation ceremony).
Looking forward to continue our discussion regarding the proposition I offered when we last met.
gino
